title: Not spillproof!
text:
Not spillproof!. I would have given 5 stars but ...
Lid is not leak proof.
I bought this for my 82 yr old mom ... she has had several massive strokes in past few months and can't hold a heavy bulky mug. So I thought this would be perfect since its suppose to be "spillproof" but nope.

product_metadata.title: FineDine Insulated Stainless-Steel Coffee Mug with Lid and Handle (2 Pk) 14 oz (Modern Lava Gray)
features: BEST IN COFFEE MUGS: FineDine's insulated stainless steel coffee mug with a lid and handle is the perfect solution for tea, coffee, and hot chocolate. Enjoy your beverages hot or cold with no mess. These 14 oz mugs come in modern lava gray and make an ideal travel mug.
KEEPS EVERYTHING HOT OR COLD: These stainless steel cups are insulated and have a vacuum seal to provide maximum insulation. Keep your beverages hot or cold for hours without any temperature changes.

QUALITY CONSTRUCTION: The stainless steel mugs are built with a powder coating and a brushed finish. The ergonomic handle fits four fingers comfortably and the lid is spill-resistant with an easy-to-use dial.
TRAVEL APPROVED: Don't worry about spills in your bag or car. This tumbler is designed for convenience on the go. It fits perfectly in any cup holder and will surely be your favorite travel mug.
VERSATILE USE: This insulated stainless steel mug is perfect for beer, cola, cocktails, and other cold beverages. Enjoy warm tea or coffee at the office, at home, or in outdoor activities.
